name: psn_toxic_counter
covers: mods/gen1/conditions/psn.rs onAfterMoveSelf: poison damage times the Toxic counter kept through Rest (Toxic, Rest, wake, Poison Powder); PS: data/mods/gen1/conditions.ts psn.onAfterMoveSelf
expect: Toxic's counter is retained after Rest and applies to PSN/BRN.

name: brn_toxic_counter
covers: mods/gen1/conditions/brn.rs onAfterMoveSelf: burn damage times the Toxic counter kept through Rest (Toxic, Rest, wake, a Fire Blast burn); PS: data/mods/gen1/conditions.ts brn.onAfterMoveSelf
expect: Toxic's counter is retained after Rest and applies to PSN/BRN.

name: substitute_own_bide

name: substitute_zero_damage
covers: mods/gen1/conditions/substitute.rs onTryHit: 0 damage to a standing doll, no recoil (Wrap against a Ghost behind a Substitute); PS: data/mods/gen1/moves.ts substitute.condition.onTryHit

name: recover_255
covers: mods/gen1/moves/recover.rs onHit: the 255/511 failure (three level-85 Seismic Tosses, then Recover); PS: data/mods/gen1/moves.ts recover.onHit

name: psywave_level_1
covers: mods/gen1/moves/psywave.rs damageCallback: the soft-lock levels (a level-1 Psywave user); PS: data/mods/gen1/moves.ts psywave.damageCallback

name: counter_first_slot_sleep
covers: mods/gen1/moves/counter.rs damageCallback: the first-slot Counter desync hint (the target switched in, slept, and has Counter in the last selected slot); PS: data/mods/gen1/moves.ts counter.damageCallback
expect: it will fail if the move in the target's first slot is also Counter.

name: bide_haze_sleep
covers: mods/gen1/scripts.rs runMove: the cannotmove hint for a Bide user (Bide, put to sleep, Haze before it moves); PS: data/mods/gen1/scripts.ts runMove
expect: when Haze cures the sleep/freeze status of a Pokémon during Bide

name: nomove_disable
covers: mods/gen1/scripts.rs runMove: the nomove Fissure (frozen on the switch-in turn, thawed by Ember before any move was selected); mods/gen1/conditions/disable.rs onBeforeMove with nomove; PS: data/mods/gen1/scripts.ts runMove, data/mods/gen1/moves.ts disable.condition.onBeforeMove
expect: if a Pokémon is thawed from freeze and no move has been selected yet

name: transform_disable_slot
covers: mods/gen1/conditions/disable.rs onDisableMove: the disabled slot is past the move list after Transform; PS: data/mods/gen1/moves.ts disable.condition.onDisableMove

name: leechseed_bide_ko
covers: mods/gen1/conditions/leechseed.rs onAfterMoveSelf: nothing to leech into (Bide's release faints the seeder, then the aborted move's AfterMoveSelf); PS: data/mods/gen1/moves.ts leechseed.condition.onAfterMoveSelf

name: defense_rollover_zero
covers: mods/gen1/scripts.rs getDamage: defense rolls over to 0 (Def 256, Barrier, Reflect: 1024 / 4 truncated to 8 bits); PS: data/mods/gen1/scripts.ts getDamage
expect: Pokemon Showdown avoids division by zero by rounding defense up to 1.

name: rules_scalemons_secondary
covers: mods/gen1/rules/species_mods.rs scalemons_gen1 (rule:scalemonsmodgen1 onModifySpecies: toward 500, spd = spa) and guaranteedsecondarymod.rs (a move with secondaries and one without); PS: data/mods/gen1/rulesets.ts scalemonsmod, data/rulesets.ts guaranteedsecondarymod
expect: |rule|Scalemons Mod: Every Pokemon's stats, barring HP, are scaled to come as close to a BST of 500 as possible

name: rules_350cup
covers: mods/gen1/rules/species_mods.rs three_fifty_cup_gen1 (Rattata and Caterpie under 350, Snorlax and Chansey over; spd = spa); PS: data/mods/gen1/rulesets.ts 350cupmod
expect: |rule|350 Cup Mod: If a Pokemon's BST is 350 or lower, all of its stats get doubled.

name: rules_badnboosted
covers: mods/gen1/rules/species_mods.rs bad_n_boosted (stats at or below 70 doubled, the others kept); PS: data/rulesets.ts badnboostedmod
expect: |rule|Bad 'n Boosted Mod: All of a Pokemon's base stats below 70 are doubled.
